description: Bus Lanes - Local Streets is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Bus lanes are travel lanes that are restricted to buses during certain hours of the day. All bus lanes have signs posted along the route with specific regulations; lanes marked "Bus Only" and /or painted red. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are mta, bus, lanes. The table has 29 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2026-04-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
